name: Angel City
source:
Yuichi is a quiet, apathetic boy who has always loved listening. One weekend at his grandfather’s house he finds an old radio. Its static does not stay in the drawer.

Over the next seven days, the noise follows him through school, through the streets, through the wires that hang over the whole city. A strange boy at the school gates seems to know exactly what Yuichi hears. His best friend Daiki tries to pull him back into ordinary life. And somewhere behind it all hangs Heaven: not a paradise, but a system.

[From [url=https://ghostfuneral.itch.io/angel-city]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雄一是个安静淡漠、向来喜欢侧耳倾听的少年。某个周末，他在外公家翻出了一台老旧收音机。然而里面的电流杂音并未乖乖留在抽屉里。

在接下来的七天里，那阵杂音如影随形地跟着他穿过校园、穿过街道、穿过悬在整座城市上空的密布电线。校门口的一名古怪少年似乎对雄一听到的声音了如指掌，挚友大辉则竭力想把他拉回正常的日常生活。而在这一切背后，悬立着“天国”——那并非乐园，而是一套冰冷的系统。

[摘自[url=https://ghostfuneral.itch.io/angel-city]itch.io[/url]]
